page_title: VAL 1-2 RMA | Valencia v Real Madrid 03/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The match has just finished.
90+11' Luis Rioja (Valencia) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal!
90+8' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) trips an opposition player and Cesar Soto Grado signals a foul. It's a free kick to Valencia, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
90+7' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) comes onto the pitch so that Jude Bellingham can be given a rest.
90+5' 1 - 2 Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) receives the ball after one of the defenders fails to make a clearance and sends the ball into the back of the net!
90+3' Real Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+2' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Real Madrid get a corner.
90+2' Neat passing move from Real Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) replacing Yarek Gasiorowski.
88' Substitution. Andre Almeida did his best and is replaced by Dani Gomez (Valencia).
87' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.

85' 1 - 1 Goal! Jude Bellingham displays great vision and sends a pass to Luka Modric (Real Madrid), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:1.

84' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Real Madrid are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
81' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luka Modric (Real Madrid) replaces Dani Ceballos.
79' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
78' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
78' The referee is firm and issues Stole Dimitrievski (Valencia) a deserved yellow card.

78' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid), but referee Cesar Soto Grado must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
76' The possession of the ball – 37:63.
73' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) dinks a cross into the box from the free kick. However, the opposition defence thwarts the attack, preventing anyone from finishing.
73' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) makes a slide tackle, but referee Cesar Soto Grado blows for a foul.
69' Sergi Canos (Valencia) picked up a yellow card from referee.
68' The attendance is 46420.
68' The substitution is prepared. Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ferland Mendy.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rodrygo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid).
68' Carlos Corberan prepares a substitution. Javi Guerra is replaced by Hugo Guillamon (Valencia).
67' That's the end of the game for Diego Lopez, who is replaced by Sergi Canos (Valencia).

66' Real Madrid are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
64' Stole Dimitrievski (Valencia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
62' Stole Dimitrievski (Valencia) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' The goal by Real Madrid is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
61' Wait! Referee Cesar Soto Grado has indicated he is going to review the Real Madrid goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
60' Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Jude Bellingham. The score is 1:1.
58' The corner kick from Luis Rioja (Valencia) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
58' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Javi Guerra (Valencia). The ball goes out for a corner. Valencia can continue in their attacking effort.
55' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) fails to score from the penalty as his shot only hits the right post.
54' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
53' A player from Valencia pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Penalty awarded! Real Madrid will take a penalty kick.
49' Real Madrid work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
49' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
47' One of the Valencia players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Cesar Soto Grado has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Valencia concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. Real Madrid win a free kick.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' It will be a corner kick for Real Madrid.

44' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Stole Dimitrievski makes a great save to stop his effort. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
42' It's a nice effort by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Stole Dimitrievski. Easy save.
41' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.

38' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
36' The referee can't ignore those comments and Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) sees a yellow card for bad language.
34' Real Madrid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

34' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Real Madrid manage to earn a corner.
33' Referee Cesar Soto Grado sees the trip by Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Real Madrid are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
32' Diego Lopez (Valencia) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
31' Diego Lopez (Valencia) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
30' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) sends a long ball in, but Stole Dimitrievski comfortably gathers the ball.
27' 1 - 0 Goal! Hugo Duro (Valencia) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 1:0.
26' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
25' One of the Valencia players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
22' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
20' Real Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

20' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) attempts to find Kylian Mbappe with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The referee signals a corner kick to Real Madrid.
19' Total attempts – 5:3.
16' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
13' Valencia have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

13' A pass into the box finds Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Thibaut Courtois denies him. Valencia force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
11' Real Madrid show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
8' Hugo Duro (Valencia) receives a quality pass inside the box and fires a first-time shot. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by the goalkeeper.
6' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Stole Dimitrievski is equal to it and makes an easy save.
5' Valencia are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.
2' Real Madrid are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Real Madrid will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Cesar Soto Grado.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
